items.title: 61427_Happy Caldwell oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...it might have been he would have been that Paul Robeson. Lois Deppe [INTERVIEWEE] That's right. ... Yes, because Fletcher had the band in that show.

ctx.x: And that was almost a quirk of fate with him because he was the one that sang 'Without a Song' in that show, 'Great Day,' and if 'Showboat' hadn't come along, which was, you know, a story of the South (unintelligible), I mean that killed 'Great Day,' but I mean if he -- if that show had come along (unintelligible), it might have been he would have been that Paul Robeson. Lois Deppe
